footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to CytomX: after $3.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 44.8% to $76.2M in 2025. The company had an operating loss of $22.4M, versus operating income of $25.0M.
The company had a net loss of $20.4M, or −$0.15 per share, versus net income of $31.9M. Operating cash flow was −$75.6M and free cash flow −$75.8M, versus −$86.5M.
sources: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
